name: the new-chat home screen with the greeting and the composer

regions_read.verdict_on_region: unconventional (mid-screen): greets the signed-in user by name; names a person, not a place (live app now reads "Good afternoon, Ally Cooper" — the wording changes with time of day) — dismissed as not naming a place

identifier_found: none; the top bar carries only an unlabeled three-line menu glyph and a ghost glyph, and the mid-screen text is a greeting
accessibility_text: content_description on the root names nothing; the only descriptions are control names ("Open menu", "Incognito chat", "Add to chat", "Start speech input", "Voice Mode") — nothing in the accessibility layer names this screen either
initial_rationale: no title in the top bar and no active navigation; the only large text greets the user; the composer placeholder "Chat with Claude…" hints at chatting but does not name the screen

test_cases.precondition: app open on the new-chat home screen, composer empty
test_cases.action: swipe up and down across the screen, watching for a title, a collapsing app bar or any name for the screen
test_cases.expected_result: either a title appears in some scroll position, or the screen never names itself
test_cases.confirms_if: no title or section name appears in any position; the top bar keeps only the menu and ghost glyphs
test_cases.overturns_if: a title or section name appears in the top bar or on scroll
test_cases.observed_result: the screen does not scroll; the top bar shows only the three-line menu glyph and the ghost glyph; the only large text is "Good afternoon, Ally Cooper"; no title in any state

test_cases.precondition: app open on the home screen
test_cases.action: read the mid-screen greeting marked by the detector and decide whether it names a part of the app
test_cases.expected_result: the greeting either names a place (e.g. "New chat") or only addresses the user
test_cases.confirms_if: the text addresses the user and names no place
test_cases.overturns_if: the text names the screen or section
test_cases.observed_result: live text is "Good afternoon, Ally Cooper" (capture: "Back at it, Ally Cooper") — a greeting to the user; it names a person, not a place in the app

deciding_evidence: no identifier in any state on the live app; the greeting names the user, not the screen; the drawer opened from here highlights no section (s2), so even the app does not say which section this is. No evaluated transition lands here (the capture has no scroll edges); the harness return edges b10/b18/b19 land here and are not judged.
recommendation: add a visible title to the empty top bar — e.g. "New chat" — and highlight a matching item in the drawer when it is opened from here
